Lina (support): FYI inbound from BigRetail (BR-9987). They want streaming completions that emit typed JSON objects as they arrive (inventory updates, pricing blocks), plus the model should be able to call an internal `price_check` tool and include the tools partial results inline. Ticket: https://support.redwood.com/BR-9987

Priya (product): Clarify: they expect the stream to contain validated schema fragments (e.g., `inventory.v2`) as the model generates, and tool outputs should be labeled and resumable?

Lina (support): Exactly. Example flow: tokens -> structured fragment (inventory) -> tool_call(price_check) -> structured_fragment(result) -> tokens. They want the fragments to be schema-validated client-side and server-side.

Diego (eng): We currently stream raw tokens or full JSON at the end. Two options: 1) JSONL envelope per line over the streaming endpoint (each line = envelope with type+payload+schema_id), or 2) SSE with typed events and a schema registry lookup. JSONL might be easier for SDKs.

Ellen (sales): BigRetail is ok with beta access and could sign for Dedicated if it proves stable. They prefer a single HTTP connection (no webhooks).

Ravi (security): Need to confirm tool execution permissions for customer-managed tools. Also audit logging per tool call required for compliance.

Diego (eng): Constraints: ordered delivery, backpressure across tool calls, partial validation path, and resumability after network interruption (resume token or sequence id). Also need a way to represent validation failures inline without breaking the stream.

Priya (product): Proposal draft: Add parameter `response_mode=structured_stream` and `envelope=jsonl|sse` (default jsonl). Envelopes: {"seq":n, "type":"token|structured|tool_call|tool_update|error|done", "schema":"inventory.v2", "payload":...}. Acceptance criteria for beta: SDK iterators in Node/Py, schema registry docs, failure semantics, and per-fragment latency metrics.

UI-Bot: Reminder: design sync Thu 3pm (add to calendar).

Diego (eng): Quick example (JSONL lines):

{"seq":1,"type":"token","payload":"The system detects "}
{"seq":2,"type":"structured","schema":"inventory.v2","payload":{"sku":"123","qty_partial":10}}
{"seq":3,"type":"tool_call","payload":{"tool":"price_check","id":"pc-77"}}
{"seq":4,"type":"tool_update","payload":{"id":"pc-77","partial":true,"prices":[{"region":"us","price":9.99}]}}
{"seq":5,"type":"structured","schema":"price_response.v1","payload":{"sku":"123","price":9.99}}
{"seq":6,"type":"done"}

Diego (eng): Implementation plan (MVP): design doc & schema registry extension (1 week), stream envelope parser + SDK iterator (2 sprints), internal canary with Dedicated customer (1 sprint), public beta (2 sprints). ETA ~6-7 weeks if prioritized.

Priya (product): Launch checklist: schema versioning guide, SDK samples, error-handling recommendations (emit type=error with recoverability flags), contract for tool permissions, RBAC mapping, and migration guide for `token` customers. Also define SLOs: 95th pctl per-fragment latency <200ms for supported models.

Lina (support): BigRetail ok to be early adopter. Wants a canary next week. Assigned: Lina to coordinate acceptance tests.

Ellen (sales): I'll confirm commercial terms for Dedicated beta and loop legal for data residency clauses.

Ravi (security): We'll need an audit log format for tool calls and a mode to disable third-party tools in Private deployments.

Diego (eng): Interim workaround: we can ship token stream + JSONL side-channel over the same HTTP connection using multipart boundaries. Lower engineering risk and meets single-connection preference. Document as "interim-mode".

Priya (product): Prioritization: mark as P1 for BigRetail beta. If performance meets SLOs, GA in next quarter. Action items: Diego - RFC + POC for JSONL by Tue EOD. UI - provide timeline for embedded structured rendering. Lina - test plan with customer. Ellen - commercial terms. Ravi - audit requirements doc.

Lina (support): Thanks all 8522; I'll update ticket BR-9987 with the plan and schedule the canary.
